Name: Stingray Island South
Author: dfs168
Description:
Are you tired of those pesky villagers randomly hanging out at the resort every sunny day (except festival days)? It's another location you have to look for them. Sure, you can close the resort for the next day at the changing rooms but that's another chore you need to remember. Perhaps you simply enjoy the solitude on the Island. The problem is you want a stingray pond or for your fishing achievement so you have to build the resort to get to the cave where the stingrays hang out.

This mod simply allows you to catch stingrays at the Island South location. You can build the resort later when you're good and ready or not if you choose to pay the Joja parrot for the final golden walnuts that are located at the Island West Cove.

Downloads.Description: Allow stingrays to be caught at the Island South location.

Manifest.Description: Stingrays have migrated to the south of the Island
